title: Interactive 90-Degree Angle Constructor
description: A fully responsive, step-by-step interactive tool for constructing a 90-degree angle at any point O on a line. Learn mode shows an animated SVG construction with 4 steps. Practice mode presents 5 MCQ questions. Built with Singularity Design System (Poppins, #4A4DC9/#FF7212). Adapts to all screen sizes via ResizeObserver-based container queries.
teaching_notes: This tool builds directly on the perpendicular bisector construction. The key insight is that O is already on the bisector, so only one pair of arcs is needed. This is not a new method — it is the same technique applied strategically.
instructions_for_student: Learn to construct a perfect 90-degree angle at any point on a line using the perpendicular bisector method. Then test your understanding with MCQ questions in Practice mode.

responsive.strategy: Container-query based via ResizeObserver measuring actual component width. No CSS media queries — purely JavaScript-driven for iframe/embed compatibility.

responsive.svgBehavior: SVG uses viewBox='0 0 700 400' and width:100% — scales proportionally within any container width. All geometry coordinates are in SVG units, not pixels, so the construction looks identical at all sizes.
responsive.containerWidth: Set to width:100% with maxWidth from props.width (default 800px) and margin:0 auto for centering. Fills parent container naturally on mobile.

step1.text: Goal: Construct a 90° angle at point O using compass and straightedge only.

step2.text: By marking OX = OY, we made O the midpoint of segment XY. The perpendicular bisector of XY must pass through O!

step3.text: Since O is already on the perpendicular bisector, we only need ONE more point on it. One pair of arcs gives us point A.

step4.text: Key Insight: The 90° angle construction is just the perpendicular bisector applied to a segment whose midpoint is your chosen point O.

learn.description: Animated SVG construction with 4 progressive steps, annotation panel, description, and navigation.

practice.description: 5 MCQ questions with score tracking, explanations, gradient buttons.

steps.question: What angle does ray OA make?

tool_objectives.instructions_for_student: Here is a line with point O marked. Goal: construct a 90° angle at O.
Mark X and Y equidistant from O. O is now the midpoint of XY!
Draw arcs from X and Y above the line. Only ONE pair needed!
Draw ray OA — exactly 90° on both sides!
Test your understanding with 5 MCQ questions.
